question: **Choose the incorrectly spelt word. **
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e.** 'Happilly'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word is: **'Happilly'.**
 
• The correct spelling is **"Happily"**.(खुशी से)
 
• The general rule is that when the base adjective ends in a consonant plus "y", you change the "y" to "i" and add "ly" to form the adverb.
 
• So "happy" becomes "happily".

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Happilly'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's go through the other options:
 
 
• **'Barely'** is correctly spelled. It means only just; scarcely.(मुश्किल से)
 
• **'Boldly'** is correctly spelled. It means in a confident and courageous way.(साहसपूर्वक)
 
• **'Lastly' **is also correctly spelled. It means after everything else; finally.(अंत में)
